tables.name: Other Locations
tables.description: Rolled once for each of the village's other locations. Even a usual shop or service may not be run as such in a village: it may not take typical payment, or may be run out of someone's home. (B) Basic, (S) Specialty, (E) Exotic. A location rolled twice is another location.

results.name: Baker
results.description: (Basic) Bakes and sells fresh bread and, possibly, pastries.

results.name: Butcher
results.description: (Basic) Processes and sells fresh and/or dried meat.

results.name: Cooper
results.description: (Basic) Crafts wooden vessels held together with metal hoops, including barrels, buckets, etc.

results.name: Carpenter
results.description: (Basic) Builds with or carves wood, as well as carrying out repairs.

results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Herbalist
results.description: (Basic) Sells common herbs and natural, non-magical remedies.

results.name: Smithy
results.description: (Basic) Sells and crafts metal tools and equipment, including very basic weapons and armor.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Tanner/Taxidermist
results.description: (Basic) Processes animal hides for practical or ornamental purposes.

results.name: Thatcher
results.description: (Basic) Builds roofs using layers of dried straw, reeds, rushes, etc.

results.name: Wainwright
results.description: (Basic) Builds carts and wagons.

results.name: Weaver
results.description: (Basic) Weaves raw fabric and baskets.

results.name: Alchemist
results.description: (Specialty) Brews and sells potions, as well as mundane herbs and alchemical ingredients.

results.name: Artist
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses painter, sculptor or other visual art as appropriate.

results.name: Cobbler
results.description: (Specialty) Makes and mends boots and shoes.

results.name: Mill
results.description: (Specialty) Facilities for milling grain.

results.name: Shipwright
results.description: (Specialty) Builds and launches boats and/or ships. Only next to a significant source of water (Coastal or River); otherwise rerolled.

results.name: Rare Botanicals
results.description: (Exotic) Cultivates and sells herbs rare to the region.

results.name: Luxury Furnishings
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells all manner of home items for fine living, including furniture, art, and other high-quality goods.

results.name: Rare Libations & Fare
results.description: (Exotic) Sells (and, perhaps, makes or brews) drinks and/or food of surpassing quality or rarity to the region.

results.name: Rare Trade Goods
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells items and materials, such as ores or textiles, that are rare to the region.

results.name: Magic Shop - Armor
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on armor and protective equipment.

results.name: Magic Shop - Books
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on literature, arcane tomes and lore. They may also carry books and documents (such as maps and records) of a rare and significant nature, though non-magical.

results.name: Magic Shop - Clothing
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on clothing of all types which bear magical properties.

results.name: Magic Shop - Jewelry
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on enchanted, or otherwise magically imbued, jewelry.

results.name: Magic Shop - Weapons
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on weapons with mystic properties and, perhaps, shields.

results.name: Magic Shop - Miscellaneous & Curiosities
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells magical items with a focus on strange and rare artifacts of a wondrous or intriguing nature.

results.name: Barber
results.description: Provides grooming services, such as haircuts or shaves.

results.name: Bathhouse
results.description: Provides spaces for bathing.

results.name: Doctor/Apothecary
results.description: Provides medical care.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Inn
results.description: Provides accommodation, as well as a place to have a bath and a decent meal.

results.name: Soothsayer
results.description: Provides magical prediction and prophecy - sayers of sooth!

results.name: Stable
results.description: Provides boarding accommodation for mounts, as well as selling carts, animals, and their tack.

results.name: Tavern
results.description: Provides food and drink.

results.name: Burned Down or Abandoned Business
results.description: This used to be a place of business, but isn’t anymore. Roll once more on this table (Former Business) to see what it was.
